hints.title: Shrinking Bitwise AND Set
hints.text: The bitwise and operation is monotonic non-increasing. A subarray ending at index i can produce at most 30 distinct bitwise and values.

hints.title: Maintain Active Set
hints.text: As you iterate through the array, compute the new set of bitwise and values by combining each value from the previous set with the current element.

hints.title: Track Minimum Difference
hints.text: Compare each unique value in the current set with target, updating the minimal absolute difference seen.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time, giving TLE for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since each and operation can only turn 1s into 0s, at most 30 unique values can end at any index, keeping set size tiny.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate exploits the 30-bit finiteness property of bitwise and to reduce state space from quadratic to O(30*N).
